overview: Costa Rica is a small country in Central America, between Nicaragua and Panama. Its capital and largest city is San José. Costa Rica abolished its army in 1948 and is known for being peaceful and stable. It protects a large share of its land in national parks and reserves, and nature tourism is a big part of its economy.

geography.text: Costa Rica has coastlines on both the Caribbean Sea and the Pacific Ocean. A chain of mountains and volcanoes runs down the middle of the country, and the Central Valley among them is where most people live. Rainforests, cloud forests and beaches make it one of the most biodiverse places in the world for its size.
